opportunities.title: The Open Fund for Music Creators
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based music creators (songwriters, composers, artists, bands, producers or performers who write their own music) of all genres and backgrounds at different stages of their career.
opportunities.summary: Supports the development of outstanding music creators with grants of up to £5,000 for projects fulfilling the funding priorities of supporting the creation, performance and promotion of outstanding new music, enabling UK music creators to realise their potential, and reaching audiences.

opportunities.title: Early Career Promoter Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Emerging/early career independent promoters in England.
opportunities.summary: Offers grant funding and capacity building support for independent promoters, covering booking, programming and promotion of gigs/concerts/club nights/showcases/tours, related costs, capacity building, and other expenditure to programme diverse artists and build sustainable careers in the grassroots music sector. Managed by PRS Foundation with Arts Council England and DCMS.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Music Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based artists/bands writing their own music who are breaking through to the next level of their careers.
opportunities.summary: Offers grants of £5k-£15k for UK-based artists/bands to break through to the next level, supporting recording, touring and marketing. Run by PRS Foundation in partnership with PPL, Creative Wales and Arts Council of Northern Ireland.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Accelerator Liverpool
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Songwriters, artists, bands and performers writing their own music, and future industry professionals, based in Liverpool City Region.
opportunities.summary: Targeted scheme to support the development of outstanding artists and bands outside London who face additional barriers based on location, providing financial support of up to £5k to reach or get beyond early career tipping points, plus access to industry-facing platforms, knowledge and advice.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Accelerator Tees Valley
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Songwriters, artists, bands and performers writing their own music, and future industry professionals, based in Tees Valley.
opportunities.summary: Targeted scheme to support the development of outstanding artists and bands outside London who face additional barriers based on location, providing financial support of up to £5k to reach or get beyond early career tipping points, plus access to industry-facing platforms, knowledge and advice.

opportunities.title: Composers' Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Composers with a strong track record who are already making a significant cultural contribution in the UK and have potential for greater impact in the UK and overseas.
opportunities.summary: Provides direct funding access at pivotal career stages, supporting up to 15 composers per year who can make the case for support enabling a significant step change in their career. Supports recordings, promotion and performance of existing works, international co-commissions, residencies, sabbaticals, childcare costs and more.

opportunities.title: The Hitmaker Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Songwriters and producers working in popular music genres.
opportunities.summary: Offers grants of between £5,000 and £10,000 for songwriters and producers in popular music genres to further develop their careers and writing/production. Delivered by PRS Foundation (formerly the Writer Producer Fund).

opportunities.title: Women Make Music
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Women, trans and non-binary songwriters, composers, artists, bands and performers who are writing their own music.
opportunities.summary: Supports the development of outstanding women, trans and non-binary songwriters and composers of all genres and backgrounds at different stages of their career. In 2026 there will be one bumper deadline in the second half of the year while recommendations of the Women Make Music report are being implemented.

opportunities.title: International Showcase Fund (ISF)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based artists, bands, songwriters and producers who have been formally invited to perform or create new music at international industry-facing showcasing festivals, songwriting camps or conferences.
opportunities.summary: Offers grants of up to £5,500 for international export opportunities for UK-based music creators invited to international industry-facing events. Rollings deadlines; the SXSW 2026 deadline has closed.

opportunities.title: Resonate
opportunities.summary: Fund and resource encouraging professional orchestras to programme the best British orchestral music written in the last 25 years, offering grants of up to £10K to orchestras committing to exploring contemporary UK repertoire as part of a season/tour and longer term audience development programme.
